correctness.rationale: Every word with A>=2 letters a uniquely has gaps b^(x0)a b^(x1)...a b^(xA). The scattered a b^r a pattern occurs exactly when p=sum(x1..x_(A-1))>=r. The exact count by |w|_(ab)=sum(i x_i) factors over p<r as q^p Gaussian[A+p-2,p] times sum_(v=0)^(B-p) q^(Av). For r=3, the p=0,1 terms contribute 1 in every feasible C, and the p=2 interior indices i<=j give the finite sum h_A(i+j), at most two possible residue lifts. Counting unordered nonzero residue pairs modulo A bounds each fiber by 1+floor(A/2), with equality at C=A when B>=2. Independent brute binary scattered-pattern enumeration tested all C for (A,B)=(3,3),(4,4),(5,3). The infinite parameter formulas follow the gap bijection, not experiments.
